Acceptable Use Policy — Purpose and Scope
This policy defines the acceptable use of the organisation’s information, information assets, and IT facilities. It applies to all employees, contractors, and third parties who access organisational systems or data, on any device, whether on or off premises.

corpus.title: Acceptable Use Policy
corpus.heading: Introduction
corpus.text:
Acceptable Use Policy — Introduction
Information and the systems that process it are valuable assets. Used appropriately they enable the business; used carelessly they expose the organisation to legal, financial, and reputational harm. Every user shares responsibility for protecting these assets and must act in line with this policy at all times.

corpus.title: Acceptable Use Policy
corpus.heading: Business use of information assets
corpus.text:
Acceptable Use Policy — Business use of information assets
Information assets are provided primarily for legitimate business purposes. Users must access only the information required to perform their role, must not bypass or disable security controls, and must protect their authentication credentials. Loss, theft, or suspected compromise of any asset must be reported to IT without delay.

corpus.title: Acceptable Use Policy
corpus.heading: Personal use of information assets
corpus.text:
Acceptable Use Policy — Personal use of information assets
Limited, reasonable personal use is permitted provided it does not interfere with work, consume disproportionate resources, incur cost to the organisation, or breach any policy or law. The organisation may monitor use of its systems in accordance with applicable law.

corpus.title: Acceptable Use Policy
corpus.heading: Use of email and other electronic communication
corpus.text:
Acceptable Use Policy — Use of email and other electronic communication
Email and messaging must be used professionally. Users must not send confidential information to unauthorised recipients, open unexpected attachments or links, or use organisational addresses for personal registrations, spam, or unlawful content. Suspected phishing must be reported, not actioned.

corpus.title: Acceptable Use Policy
corpus.heading: Use of internet
corpus.text:
Acceptable Use Policy — Use of internet
Internet access is provided for business use. Users must not access, store, or distribute material that is illegal, offensive, or infringes intellectual-property rights, and must not download software or services that have not been approved by IT.

corpus.title: Acceptable Use Policy
corpus.heading: Use of social media
corpus.text:
Acceptable Use Policy — Use of social media
When identifiable as associated with the organisation, users must be respectful, must not disclose confidential or personal information, and must not speak on the organisation’s behalf unless explicitly authorised to do so.

corpus.title: Acceptable Use Policy
corpus.heading: Clear desk policy
corpus.text:
Acceptable Use Policy — Clear desk policy
Sensitive information in physical form must not be left unattended. Documents must be secured when away from the desk and at the end of the working day, and disposed of via approved confidential-waste channels.

corpus.title: Acceptable Use Policy
corpus.heading: Clear screen policy
corpus.text:
Acceptable Use Policy — Clear screen policy
Devices must be locked when unattended and configured to lock automatically after a short period of inactivity. Sensitive information must not be displayed where unauthorised people can view it.

corpus.title: Acceptable Use Policy

- Changes must be documented in the change log
- Obsolete documents must be archived, not deleted

5. Set new next_review_date
